title: Sean McVay on Aaron Donald: Think he'll keep working out, hope to have answer soon

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Sean McVay on Aaron Donald: Think he'll keep working out, hope to have answer soon
sources.description: The Rams have reported a pair of workouts for Aaron Donald in recent weeks and there will likely be more to come before the defensive tackle makes a decision on playing in 2026.
